001package io.jstach.rainbowgum.simple.props;
002
003import java.util.List;
004
005import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LevelResolver;
006import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogAlerts;
007import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogConfig;
008import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogProperties;
009import io.jstach.rainbowgum.ServiceRegistry;
010import io.jstach.rainbowgum.spi.RainbowGumServiceProvider;
011import io.jstach.svc.ServiceProvider;
012
013/**
014 * Makes {@link SimpleProperties} provide properties to RainbowGum.
015 * <p>
016 * If a {@link SimpleProperties} is already bound in the {@link ServiceRegistry} (for
017 * example an application put one there with a custom
018 * {@link SimpleProperties.Builder#envPrefix(String) envPrefix}/
019 * {@link SimpleProperties.Builder#resource(String) resource} before RainbowGum
020 * initializes) it is used instead of the default {@link SimpleProperties#builder()
021 * SimpleProperties.builder().build()}.
022 */
023@ServiceProvider(RainbowGumServiceProvider.class)
024public final class SimplePropertiesProvider
025                implements RainbowGumServiceProvider.PropertiesProvider, RainbowGumServiceProvider.Configurator {
026
027        /**
028         * For service loader.
029         */
030        public SimplePropertiesProvider() {
031        }
032
033        @Override
034        public List<LogProperties> provideProperties(ServiceRegistry registry, LogAlerts alerts) {
035                var simpleProperties = registry.putIfAbsent(SimpleProperties.class, () -> SimpleProperties.builder().build());
036                simpleProperties.reportAlerts(alerts);
037                var levelFile = simpleProperties.levelFile();
038                if (levelFile != null) {
039                        registry.put(LogProperties.class, LevelResolver.OVERRIDE_PROPERTIES_NAME, levelFile);
040                }
041                return simpleProperties.properties();
042        }
043
044        /*
045         * Starts watching the level file, if enabled, once the configuration exists to
046         * publish changes to; the watcher stops when the configuration closes.
047         */
048        @Override
049        public boolean configure(LogConfig config, Pass pass) {
050                var simpleProperties = config.serviceRegistry().findOrNull(SimpleProperties.class);
051                var levelFile = simpleProperties == null ? null : simpleProperties.levelFile();
052                if (levelFile != null) {
053                        config.serviceRegistry().onClose(levelFile);
054                        levelFile.watch(config);
055                }
056                return true;
057        }
058
059}
